data.name: BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO
data.detailed_description:
"Oh I can't wait for BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO"

-Civvie11

BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4 is a fast-paced ultraviolent BRAZILIAN old school FPS heavily inspired by the first Quake, and using the same engine as the game (ID TECH2). It is a standalone expansion of the hit boomer shooter BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER 3: I OPENED A PORTAL TO HELL IN THE FAVELA TRYING TO REVIVE MIT AIA I NEED TO CLOSE IT ! And It is A TRIBUTE TO THE BRAZILIAN MODS OF THE 2000S, THE BRAZILIAN BOOTLEG GAMES OF THE 2000S, BRAZILIAN MUSIC AND THE BEST BAND IN THE HISTORY OF BRAZIL, MAMADAS!

AFTER YOU SAVE MIT AIA, MACKIE JACKIE AND THE MAMADAS, YOU DO A PARTY IN HEAVEN! BUT THINGS TOOK A BAD TURN WHEN THE MAMADAS WERE KIDNAPPNED BY RONALDO MCDALEST! SAVE THEM FROM RONALDO, AND SAVE THEIR GLOBECETA PORTAL OPENER CAR TOO! RONALDO STILL HAS SOME DEMONS FROM THE INVASION AROUND! END THE REMAINING DEMONS AND SAVE RIO DE JANEIRO, SÃO PAULO AND SALVADOR! 

  • Use your quake-ish movement abilities to stay mobile and avoid the relentless attacks of the dead, demons and other BRAZILIAN POSSESSED.

  • DO A DASH AND A DOUBLE JUMP NOW CUZ YOU INSERTED FIREWORKS UP YOUR HOLE!!

  • CRAZY WEAPONS LIKE BERIMBAU, PAYPHONE THAT SHOOTS COCONUTS AND MONEY PAPER AIRPLANE GUN RETURN!! ALSO NEW ONES COME TO THE ROSTER, LIKE THE FEIJOADA (BEAN) BOWL WITH A SLINGSHOT, AND THE CHIMARRÃO DRINK FLAMETHROWER!!

  • A BUNCH OF ENEMIES GOING FROM ARMED DEMONS TO ZOMBIES, BRAZILIAN TRUCK CLOWNS AND EVEN POSSESSED BRAZILIAN SINGERS! ALSO NEW ENEMIES LIKE TWO DUDES IN A MOTORCYCLE, ANGRY TV MOUSES, AND POSSESSED SOCCER TEAM MASCOTS!

  • 18 CAMPAIGN STAGES GOING THROUGH THE ENTIRE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO, PARTS OF SÃO PAULO, SALVADOR, HELL AND EVEN HEAVEN! SAVE RIO, SÃO PAULO, SALVADOR AND SAVE THE MAMADAS!

  • LOTS OF SECRET AREAS ON EACH LEVEL!

  • -COOPERATIVE AND DEATHMATCH ON ALL CAMPAIGN MAPS

  • EASY MULTIPLAYER THROUGH STEAMWORKS! JOIN FRIENDS BY INVITING THEM! NO PORT FORWARD NEEDED!

  • -EAT PASTEL AND DRINK CANE BROTH TO GAIN HEALTH! IT'S SCATTERED ON THE MAPS!

  • REPLAY THE GAME WITH ROCKET JUMPING OR DOUBLE JUMP IN MIND TO FIND EXCLUSIVE ROCKET JUMP AND DOUBLE JUMP SECRET AREAS! OLD SCHOOL 90S STYLE!

  • ATTENTION : THE GAME WILL STILL RECEIVE CONTENT MONTHLY JUST LIKE BDD3!
